title: billbergia zebrina
intro: Billbergia zebrina, commonly known as Zebra Plant, is a species of flowering plant in the family Bromeliaceae. It is known for its unique, striped leaves that resemble a zebra's coat. The Zebra Plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties, promoting a good night's sleep, and aiding in digestion. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
